BETWEEN:-
 VINAY DUBEY @ ANKUR S/O SHRI SHRIKANT DUBEY,
AGED ABOUT 30 YEARS

, OCCUPATION: SELF  EMPLOYED R/O VILLAGE SIGTI, POLICE STATION  GARH, DISTRICT REWA (M.P.) (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI K.K. GAUTAM - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  SAMAN DISCTRICT REWA (M.P.) (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI AKSHAY NAMDEO - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.220/2022, registered at Police Station-Saman,
District-Rewa (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 454, 342, 307, 309, 376(2n), 506 of the IPC.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case diary.
It is submitted by him that husband of prosecutrix had assaulted the prosecutrix as well as applicant due to which applicant had suffered cut wounds on his wrist and neck.
Applicant remained admitted in hospital for fifteen days.
In view of same, applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

It is submitted that injury found on body of applicant was old and applicant has brutally assaulted the prosecutrix and has caused injury on her, therefore, bail application may be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. On going through the MLC report, it is found that injury suffered by applicant were only 12 hours old and it cannot be said that said injuries are because of some earlier assault on him.
Prosecution has failed to explained injuries found on the body of applicant.

6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that trial will take considerable time for its conclusion, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE shabana Vinay Dubey @ Ankur vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192762045/
